title: 第1644章 绝对的实力震慑第1643章 欲盖弥彰
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“只有他一个人？”
苏星河有些意外，千贺宗的势力范围，方圆数千里，一旦宗门修士四散逃离，别说只是金丹巅峰，就算是一位元婴境的强者，也拦不住。
“句芒一族，不但拥有木属性先天神通，并且，还能通过秘法，施展生命层次的术法，在我们闯入千贺宗之前，句程君提前将术法施展在四周的树木之上，任何经过的修士，都会被感应到！
并且，在生命层次术法加持下，他们可以尽心短距离传送，精妙之处，丝毫不逊色于空间术法传送！”
在禁忌契约的监视下，帝塔不敢隐瞒，将事先，针对千贺宗逃走修士的计划，一五一十说了一遍，甚至，连同他们为何只安排一人围堵，都于苏星河简单说了一遍。
几人针对千贺宗的突袭，有着百分百的信心，在他们的计划里，千贺宗根本就不可能有人可以逃脱，之所以留句程君，也只是以防万一。
根据帝塔所说，他们来之前，已经得知了千贺宗紫薇斩仙大阵的存在，却没想到，会有苏星河这样恐怖的存在。
可以说，正是因为苏星河展现出的强大实力，彻底打乱了他们的计划，最终，沦落到成为奴仆的境地。
“你说的句芒一族，可是先前那个老妪的族人？”
确定了帝塔没有丝毫隐瞒，苏星河满意的点了点头。
“正是，她叫句断春，也是我圣族首领。”
“掌握木属性神通的句芒一族......老妪已经被我斩杀，尸骨不剩，你去把句程君叫过来！”
苏星河回想着先前老妪的神通，微微沉吟后，对帝塔吩咐道。
“好！”
虽然不清楚苏星河要做什么，帝塔还是老老实实应声，没有与身旁的同伴招呼，背后羽翼展开，瞬间消失在众人眼前。
“祝首领，闲着也是闲着，不妨让我搜下魂？”
苏星河看向祝青锋。
“搜魂？”
祝青锋大惊。
“放心，不会伤到你的神魂！”

苏星河笑着安慰，却转头看向了封极。
“这并不是过分要求，你们入侵我千贺宗，我们只想了解一下具体情况，这并不过分！”
得到苏星河示意后，封极目光看向祝青锋，语气不容质疑。
“我拒绝！”
祝青锋不为所动。
“我的耐心有限，不是跟你商量，你也没有拒绝的资格，你要明白，我不是以其主仆契约在压你，而是用绝对碾压的实力，在要求你！
若是不同意，我不介意直接将你斩杀！”
见祝青锋不识趣，苏星河语气立刻阴沉下来。
“你......”
祝青锋嘴唇抽搐，他这才明白，苏星河并非是以主仆契约胁迫，而是仗着更强的实力，直接命令，如此说来，的确不算违背之前的约定。
“想好了没有！我的耐心可是有限的！”
“你为何不搜他们的魂，非要搜我的？”
“因为你与他们不同！”
苏星河扯了扯嘴角，眼神意味深长。
“你保证不伤我神魂？”
祝青锋虽然不清楚，苏星河说的不同，具体指的是什么，但多半与祝青山有关，为了不引起玄汐幽和蓐苍刑的怀疑，只能硬着头皮上前。
content_en:
"He's the only one?"
Su Xinghe was a little surprised. The Qianhe Sect's sphere of influence was thousands of miles in radius. Once the monks of the sect fled in all directions, not to mention those at the peak of the Golden Core, even a strong man in the Nascent Soul Realm would not be able to stop them.
"The Jumang clan not only possesses the innate magical power of the wood attribute, but can also use secret methods to cast life-level spells. Before we broke into Qianhe Sect, Mr. Jucheng cast the spell on the surrounding trees in advance, and any monks who passed by would be sensed!
Moreover, with the blessing of life-level spells, they can teleport over short distances with all their strength, and their subtlety is no less than that of space spells! "
Under the surveillance of the taboo contract, Di Tower did not dare to hide anything. He told Su Xinghe exactly what the plan was for Qianhe Sect's escaped monks beforehand. He even briefly explained to Su Xinghe why they only arranged for one person to contain them.
Several people had 100% confidence in the Qianhe Sect's raid. In their plan, it was impossible for anyone in the Qianhe Sect to escape. The reason why they left a message to Mr. Cheng was just in case.
According to Di Pa, before they came, they had already learned about the existence of the Qianhe Sect Ziwei Immortal Killing Formation, but they did not expect that there would be such a terrifying existence as Su Xinghe.
It can be said that it was precisely because of the powerful strength displayed by Su Xinghe that they completely disrupted their plans, and in the end, they were reduced to the status of slaves.
"The Jumang clan you are talking about are the clansmen of the old woman before?"
After confirming that Di Pa had not concealed anything, Su Xinghe nodded with satisfaction.
"Exactly, her name is Ju Duanchun, and she is also the leader of my holy clan."
"The Jumang clan who masters the magical power of wood...the old woman has been killed by me, and there are no bones left. Go and call Jun Jucheng over!"
Su Xinghe recalled the old woman's magical powers before, and after thinking for a moment, he gave instructions to Di Pa.
"Okay!"
Although he didn't know what Su Xinghe was going to do, Di Ta still responded honestly without saying hello to his companions. He spread his wings behind his back and disappeared in front of everyone in an instant.
"Chief Zhu, if you are idle, you are idle. Why don't you let me search for souls?"
Su Xinghe looked at Zhu Qingfeng.
"Searching for souls?"
Zhu Qingfeng was shocked.
"Don't worry, it won't hurt your soul!"
Su Xinghe comforted him with a smile, but then turned to look at Feng Ji.
"This is not too much to ask for. You invaded our Qianhe Sect. We just want to know the specific situation. This is not too much!"
After receiving Su Xinghe's signal, Feng Ji looked at Zhu Qingfeng and his tone was unquestionable.
"I refuse!"
Zhu Qingfeng remained unmoved.
"My patience is limited. I am not negotiating with you, and you have no right to refuse. You must understand that I am not suppressing you with my master-servant contract, but I am demanding you with my absolute crushing strength!
If you don't agree, I don't mind killing you directly! "
Seeing that Zhu Qingfeng was ignorant, Su Xinghe's tone immediately turned gloomy.
"You..."
Zhu Qingfeng's lips twitched, and he finally understood that Su Xinghe was not coercing through the master-servant contract, but relying on his stronger strength to give direct orders. In this way, it was indeed not a violation of the previous agreement.
"Have you thought about it? My patience is limited!"
"Why don't you search their souls instead of searching mine?"
"Because you are different from them!"
Su Xinghe twitched the corner of his mouth, his eyes meaningful.
"You promise not to hurt my soul?"
Although Zhu Qingfeng didn't know what Su Xinghe was referring to, it was probably related to Zhu Qingshan. In order not to arouse the suspicion of Xuan Xiyou and Ling Cangxing, he had no choice but to step forward.
